text:
ellie: spotted an unexpected snapshot export during routine audit. appears to be exported using the platform key instead of tenant CMK. creating thread to triage.

 tom: details? snapshot id / destination?

 ellie: snap-id: db-snap-2026-03-22-03, dest s3://partner-ingest/redwood/snap-db-snap-2026-03-22.enc, kms: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/platform-zz99. no tenant tag present.

 razi: is this a manual run or cron job? cloudtrail shows assume-role by role backup-runner@ecs at 03:01:12Z then CopyObject at 03:01:30Z.

 ops-bot: Alert: S3Copy flagged by policy "require-tenant-cmk-on-export". Object copied without tenant tag. Incident INC-2026-058 opened.

 tom: action plan: 1) quarantine object, 2) deny further PutObject by that agent, 3) revoke KMS grant for the agent, 4) inventory other snapshots encrypted under platform-zz99.

 ellie: quarantined with `aws s3 cp s3://partner-ingest/redwood/snap-db-snap-2026-03-22.enc s3://redwood-quarantine/INC-2026-058/ --metadata investigation=true`

 razi: placing temporary inline deny on backup-runner principal for s3:PutObject on partner-ingest prefix. snippet ready.

 sam: i'll run `aws kms list-grants --key-id platform-zz99` and revoke the grant tied to backup-runner. note: if we revoke and platform key remains in use, restores might fail. need storage team's OK before rotating.

 tom: also propose short-term RBAC change: remove kms:Encrypt permission for any unattended role unless the request has encryption context tenant-id or s3 tag tenant. add test to our policy-validator for exports.

 ellie: filing compliance notification and pinging vendor contract team. keep me posted before key rotation.

 razi: labelling incident severity P2. tasks assigned. will follow up with automation owners on #backup-automation.

 ops-bot: Incident update: owner sam, sla 24h, links https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-058

 sam: quick note: if we move to per-tenant CMKs for exports we'll need a rewrap pipeline for existing exported copies. adding to backlog.

 ellie: thanks team. will close thread when all tasks done.
